items.description: Spend a full day exploring the vast plains of Serengeti National Park, one of Africa's premier safari destinations. Accompanied by your experienced guide, search for the legendary Big Five while encountering cheetahs, giraffes, zebras, wildebeests, elephants, and countless other wildlife species. Every game drive offers new and unforgettable wildlife encounters across the iconic Serengeti ecosystem.

items.description: Enjoy another exciting day discovering different regions of the Serengeti. Your guide will take you to some of the park's best game-viewing areas, maximizing your chances of witnessing remarkable predator-prey interactions and other unforgettable safari moments.

Continue to the fascinating Shifting Sands, a unique volcanic ash dune constantly reshaped by the wind, before driving to Karatu.
items.accommodation: Karatu Kudu Lodge – Double/Twin Room

Continue your scenic drive through northern Tanzania, arriving at the airport in time for your late afternoon international departure flight, marking the end of your unforgettable Tanzanian safari.

Enjoy a guided walk along the lake shore, famous for its flamingos and striking red-hued waters, followed by a visit to the beautiful waterfalls hidden within the surrounding gorge. Later, experience the rich traditions of the Maasai people during a cultural village visit before settling into your lodge with magnificent views of Ol Doinyo Lengai, Tanzania's active volcanic mountain.

items.title: Lake Natron to Karatu via Mto wa Mbu Cultural Tour

items.title: Marangu Gate to Mandara Hut
items.description: After an early breakfast, transfer to Marangu Gate where registration and park formalities are completed before beginning your ascent through the lush rainforest. The trail is rich with giant ferns, ancient trees, and colorful birdlife, with opportunities to spot blue monkeys and black-and-white colobus monkeys. Arrive at Mandara Hut in the afternoon to relax and prepare for the next stage of the climb.
items.accommodation: Mandara Hut

items.title: Mandara Hut to Horombo Hut
items.description: Today's trek leaves the rainforest behind as you enter the open moorland zone. Enjoy spectacular views of Mawenzi Peak while crossing rolling heathland dotted with giant lobelias and groundsels. The gradual climb allows time for acclimatization before reaching Horombo Hut.
items.accommodation: Horombo Hut

items.title: Horombo Hut to Kibo Hut
items.description: Continue your ascent across the alpine desert, a dramatic landscape of volcanic rock and wide-open scenery. The route offers breathtaking views of both Kibo and Mawenzi peaks as you steadily make your way toward Kibo Hut, where you will rest and prepare for the summit attempt later that night.
items.accommodation: Kibo Hut

items.title: Summit Attempt – Uhuru Peak to Horombo Hut
items.description: Around midnight, begin your summit ascent under a sky filled with stars. Climb steadily to Gilman's Point before continuing along the crater rim to Uhuru Peak, the highest point in Africa at 5,895 meters. Celebrate your incredible achievement before descending back to Kibo Hut for a short rest and continuing to Horombo Hut for your overnight stay.
items.accommodation: Horombo Hut

items.title: Horombo Hut to Mandara Hut
items.description: After breakfast, descend through the beautiful moorland and into the rainforest. The changing scenery offers excellent opportunities for photography while enjoying a less demanding day on the mountain as you continue toward Mandara Hut.
items.accommodation: Mandara Hut

items.title: Mandara Hut to Marangu Gate
items.description: Complete your final descent through the rainforest to Marangu Gate, where successful climbers receive their Mount Kilimanjaro certificates. Celebrate your accomplishment with your mountain crew before departing the national park.

items.title: Transfer from Marangu Gate to Arusha
items.description: After meeting your safari guide, drive to Arusha where you can enjoy a well-deserved rest following your Kilimanjaro climb. Spend the remainder of the day relaxing at the lodge and preparing for the safari portion of your journey.

After dinner, begin a challenging nighttime ascent of Ol Doinyo Lengai, the sacred mountain of the Maasai and the world's only active carbonatite volcano, climbing under the stars for an unforgettable adventure.
